props.name: Quad Method
props.description: Method for splitting the quads into triangles

items.name: Beauty
items.description: Split the quads in nice triangles, slower method

items.name: Fixed
items.description: Split the quads on the first and third vertices

items.name: Fixed Alternate
items.description: Split the quads on the 2nd and 4th vertices

items.name: Shortest Diagonal
items.description: Split the quads along their shortest diagonal

items.name: Longest Diagonal
items.description: Split the quads along their longest diagonal

props.name: N-gon Method
props.description: Method for splitting the n-gons into triangles

items.name: Clip
items.description: Split the polygons with an ear clipping algorithm

props.name: Minimum Vertices
props.description: Triangulate only polygons with vertex count greater than or equal to this number

props.name: Keep Normals
props.description:
Try to preserve custom normals.
Warning: Depending on chosen triangulation method, shading may not be fully preserved, "Fixed" method usually gives the best result here
